t: 哈布斯堡的阿尔贝二世被加冕为匈牙利国王.
te: Albert II of Habsburg is crowned King of Hungary.
dz: 哈布斯堡的阿尔贝二世被加冕为匈牙利国王.
de: Albert II of Habsburg is crowned King of Hungary.

t: 巴塞尔理事会暂停教宗尤金四世的职务.
te: The Council of Basel suspends Pope Eugene IV.
dz: 巴塞尔理事会暂停教宗尤金四世的职务.
de: The Council of Basel suspends Pope Eugene IV.

t: 特兰西瓦尼亚农民起义的九名领导人在托尔达被处决.
te: Nine leaders of the Transylvanian peasant revolt are executed at Torda.
dz: 特兰西瓦尼亚农民起义的九名领导人在托尔达被处决.
de: Nine leaders of the Transylvanian peasant revolt are executed at Torda.

t: 哈布斯堡的阿尔贝二世成为了罗马人的国王.
te: Albert II of Habsburg becomes King of the Romans.
dz: 哈布斯堡的阿尔贝二世成为了罗马人的国王.
de: Albert II of Habsburg becomes King of the Romans.

t: 费拉拉理事会从首届会议开始,君士坦丁堡牧首,安提阿、亚历山大和耶路撒冷牧首会议的代表和教宗尤金…
te: The Council of Ferrara begins with its first session in presence of the Patriarch of Constantinople, representatives of…
dz: 费拉拉理事会从首届会议开始,君士坦丁堡牧首,安提阿、亚历山大和耶路撒冷牧首会议的代表和教宗尤金四世主持会议.
de: The Council of Ferrara begins with its first session in presence of the Patriarch of Constantinople, representatives of the Patriarchal Sees of Antioch, Alexandria and Jerusalem and Pope Eugene IV presiding.

t: 叛逆的特兰西瓦尼亚农民和贵族之间的临时妥协在科洛兹斯莫诺斯托尔修道院签署.
te: A temporary compromise between the rebellious Transylvanian peasants and the noblemen is signed in Kolozsmonostor Abbey.
dz: 叛逆的特兰西瓦尼亚农民和贵族之间的临时妥协在科洛兹斯莫诺斯托尔修道院签署.
de: A temporary compromise between the rebellious Transylvanian peasants and the noblemen is signed in Kolozsmonostor Abbey.
